BF.name: IRCM on dividends and other income from securities (12,5 %)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 140 2) (edition at 2023; LF 2024 and LFR 2024 checked: art. 140 not amended; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 140 2): income from securities (valeurs mobilières) 12,5 %, bonds issued in Burkina Faso 6 %; art. 141: half rate for the first three years of new companies.
unsupported: half rate on distributions of newly formed companies (art. 141)

BF.name: IRCM on interest on deposit and current accounts (25 % halved: 12,5 %)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 140 1) (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 140 1): income from claims (créances) 25 %, halved for interest on deposit and current accounts with banks, financial institutions, the Treasury and agricultural credit funds (art. 129); the household's interest is taken to be bank deposit interest.

BF.name: Impôt sur les revenus fonciers (18 % / 25 % on monthly rent after a 50 % abatement)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 125-126 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 125: net income = gross rent of the month or period less a flat 50 % abatement; art. 126: progressive bands 0-100 000 F 18 %, above 25 %. The household's annual rent is taken as twelve equal monthly rents.
unsupported: withholding of the IRF by tenants (Livre 1, Titre 1, chapitre 9, section 4)

BF.name: Taxe sur les plus-values immobilières (10 % of the gain)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 161-166 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 166: the tax rate is 10 %; the gain is the sale price less the acquisition price and costs (art. 164-165).
unsupported: flat 10 % (15 %) uplift of the acquisition price for costs and works (art. 165)
gain set at 75 % of the price when the acquisition price is unknown

BF.name: Taxe patronale et d'apprentissage (3 % of wages)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 228-229 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 228: base = all wages paid in money plus benefits in kind; art. 229: rate 3 %.
unsupported: 20 % abatement for members of approved management centres (art. 228 2)

BF.name: Contribution foncière, built property used as housing (0,1 % of cadastral value)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 270-271, 275-276 (art. 275 as amended by loi n° 042-2021/AN; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked)
BF.doc: art. 275: base = cadastral value set by the tax administration; art. 276 1): built property 0,1 % (housing) / 0,2 % (other use); art. 271: the main residence of persons effectively taxed to the taxe de résidence, or over 60, is exempt — the household's home is treated as exempt, other buildings as let housing.
unsupported: 0,2 % for buildings not used as housing (asset kinds do not carry the use)
companies subject to the taxe foncière des sociétés are exempt (art. 271)

BF.name: Contribution foncière, unbuilt property (0,2 % of cadastral value)
BF.doc: art. 276 2): unbuilt property 0,2 % of the cadastral value.

BF.name: Droit de mutation à titre onéreux d'immeubles (5 %)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 409-410 (art. 410 as amended by loi n° 029-2022/ALT art. 54; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked)
BF.doc: art. 410 1): transfers for consideration of immovables or real rights 5 %, on the price plus charges or an expert estimate (art. 409).
unsupported: exchanges on the higher value; sales with repurchase option 6 000 F fixed duty (art. 410 2-3)

BF.name: Droits de mutation à titre gratuit (successions and gifts, tariff by bands per degree)
BF.statute: CGI 2023 art. 478 (edition at 2023; LF 2024/LFR 2024 checked; LF 2025 not held)
BF.doc: art. 478: on each heir's or donee's net share, by fraction: up to 2 M / 2-5 M / 5-10 M / 10-50 M / above 50 M — direct line and spouses 0/0/1/2/5 %; siblings and third degree (uncles, aunts, nephews, nieces) 0/7/10/15/20 %; fourth degree and beyond and non-relatives 10/15/20/30/40 %.
unsupported: deduction of 100 % capped at 100 000 F per child from the third (art. 479)
otherRelative taken as 4th degree or beyond
